 'id',t.id,'slug',t.slug,'name',t.name,'description',t.description,'riskTier',t.risk_tier,

 'vertical',t.vertical,'aliases',t.aliases) data FROM (SELECT * FROM service_policy_capabilities t WHERE t.policy_version=$1 AND ($2::text IS NULL OR t.status=$2)
        AND ($3::text IS NULL OR t.risk_tier=$3) AND ($4='' OR position(lower($4) in lower(concat_ws(' ',t.id,t.slug,t.name,t.description,t.vertical)))>0) ORDER BY t.id ASC LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6) t  ORDER BY t.id ASC
